name: Obsidian
tagline: Search, read, and edit notes in your Obsidian vault
description: mcp-obsidian lets your AI client list, search, read, append to, and patch files in an Obsidian vault through the Local REST API community plugin.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_API_KEY
env.description: API key from the Obsidian Local REST API plugin settings.

install.notes: Requires Obsidian with the Local REST API community plugin installed and enabled.
